endpoints.description: Немедленно возвращает context_id, НЕ ждёт completion. Идеально для avoiding timeout!
Ждёт полного выполнения задачи - вызывает timeout при >15s

endpoints.returns: State snapshot: contexts, tasks, logs, notifications, log_progress
endpoints.description: Получение текущего состояния и логов выполнения

endpoints.returns: Array of tasks with uuid, name, type, state, schedule, next_run

fire_and_forget.mechanism: DeferredTask - запускает coroutine в background thread, immediately returns context_id

scheduler_result_storage.description: Каждый task хранит last_result после выполнения

webhook.notes: Нет native webhook support. Нужно реализовывать самостоятельно

sse_push.alternative: Socket.IO real-time, но требует WebSocket client

a2a_protocol.notes: A2A directory (/a0/python/a2a/) не существует или пуст. FastA2A не установлен

recommendations.title: Use /message_async for fire-and-forget
recommendations.implementation: POST to /message_async, get context_id in <1s, then poll /poll for results

recommendations.title: Create result delivery via git push
recommendations.implementation: After task completion, write result to /home/user/repos/PAI-personal/MEMORY/STATE/ and git push
recommendations.workflow: Task completes → Write JSON → git add → git commit → git push

recommendations.title: Health status file pattern
recommendations.implementation: Scheduled tasks update /home/user/repos/PAI-personal/MEMORY/STATE/health.json after each run

recommendations.title: Polling pattern for long tasks
recommendations.implementation: POST /message_async → get context_id → loop: POST /poll with context → check log_progress → when done, parse logs
recommendations.timeout_solution: Client timeout irrelevant - you get immediate ack, then poll at your pace

recommendations.title: Implement webhook endpoint in A0
recommendations.implementation: Create /a0/python/api/webhook_register.py - store callback URLs, call them on task completion
recommendations.effort: Medium - requires modification to task scheduler

limitations.workaround: Navi polls /poll endpoint or checks git repo for result files
Use dedicated_context=true for scheduled tasks, or persist to files

limitations.impact: Navi cannot use Socket.IO without WebSocket support

steps: 1. Navi POSTs to /message_async → gets context_id immediately (<1s)
2. Agent Zero processes task in background (no timeout pressure)
3. On completion, Agent Zero writes result to PAI-personal/MEMORY/STATE/
4. Agent Zero git pushes to PAI-personal repo
5. Navi polls git repo OR receives notification via file watcher
benefits: Navi can check results at its own pace
Full audit trail in git history

api_authentication.note: Most endpoints are open in default config. CSRF token available at /csrf_token
